reuse.why: Keeps calling getDateWithSkippedWeekend for non-daily schedules but adds the daily-skip rule as ad-hoc logic inside getNextDate rather than as a shared weekend predicate the other weekend-handling callers could use.

duplication.why: No copied block; the skipWeekend && !noSkipWeekend condition is just re-evaluated in a nested if next to the new skipDailyWeekend flag.

placement.why: Living in shared/schedules.ts is right, but the rule is buried in getNextDate only, mixing dateCond.value.frequency with value.schedule.data.skipWeekend, instead of next to getDateWithSkippedWeekend where weekend policy is defined.

scope.why: Only getNextDate and its tests change.

maintainability.why: A magic take=4 window, a start-date guard and a nested if (!skipDailyWeekend) inside if (skipWeekend) make the function harder to follow, and the rule is not available to getUpcomingDates or schedule-template, which keep moving daily weekend occurrences.

one_place.where: The daily-skip rule exists only inline in shared/schedules.ts getNextDate; server/schedules/app.ts getUpcomingDates and server/budget/schedule-template.ts still apply getDateWithSkippedWeekend to daily schedules unchanged
